scripts.deploy: rm -f deployment.zip && zip -r deployment.zip . -x '*.git*' -x '*.zip' -x '*.DS_Store' > /dev/null && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name tvScheduleServices --zip-file fileb://deployment.zip --no-cli-pager --output text > /dev/null && aws lambda wait function-updated --function-name tvScheduleServices && aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name tvScheduleServices --environment 'Variables={SSM_STORE=/tvss/.env-production}' --no-cli-pager --output text > /dev/null && aws lambda wait function-updated --function-name tvScheduleServices && VERSION=$(aws lambda publish-version --function-name tvScheduleServices --no-cli-pager --output json | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).Version))") && (aws lambda update-alias --function-name tvScheduleServices --name prod --function-version $VERSION --no-cli-pager --output text > /dev/null 2>&1 || aws lambda create-alias --function-name tvScheduleServices --name prod --function-version $VERSION --no-cli-pager --output text > /dev/null) && echo '✅ Successfully deployed, published, and prod alias updated'
